OrchestrationPlan.title: OrchestrationPlan
OrchestrationPlan.description: Tenant-scoped, caller-authored orchestration plan: steps as typed action-proposal references (never embedded action semantics).

OrchestrationRecordVersion.title: OrchestrationRecordVersion
OrchestrationRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized agent-orchestration record (currently 1).

OrchestrationTenantId.title: OrchestrationTenantId
OrchestrationTenantId.description: Opaque tenant scope of an orchestration document: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

PlanId.title: PlanId
PlanId.description: Opaque orchestration plan identity: "plan:" followed by a lowercase slug.

OrchestrationPrincipalId.title: OrchestrationPrincipalId
OrchestrationPrincipalId.description: Opaque principal reference: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description: Authored plan step: an exact-revision action proposal reference, the assigned agent, dependencies, and a retry policy.

StepId.title: StepId
StepId.description: Plan-local step identity: a bare lowercase slug, unique within its plan.

AgentId.title: AgentId
AgentId.description: Registered agent identifier: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ProposalReference.title: ProposalReference
ProposalReference.description: Exact-revision proposal reference: id plus the SHA-256 digest of the canonical proposal.

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Opaque message identifier, unique within the emitting scope.

RetryPolicy.title: RetryPolicy
RetryPolicy.description: Retry policy as typed data: total dispatch attempts allowed and the action phases that re-queue the step.

RetryableActionPhase.title: RetryableActionPhase
RetryableActionPhase.description: Action lifecycle phases a retry policy may cover: rejected or failed.
